You’ve been heads-down for a while. Close your eyes for a minute.

string-array.name: reminder_eye_fact_texts
string-array.item: Close your eyes and the brain slips into alpha rhythm — the 8–12 Hz wave of calm, wakeful rest.
Nearly a third of your cortex is devoted to vision. Shut your eyes and you hand that capacity back.
Eyes closed, the default mode network takes over — where the mind wanders, reflects, and consolidates.
A brief eyes-closed pause lowers cortical arousal, slows the breath, and settles the heart rate.
Just 60 seconds with eyes shut measurably reduces visual fatigue and mental load.
